title: WPMS/1164/2021 of MEGHA DABRAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
ON THE 25TH DAY OF JUNE, 2021
BEFORE:
HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1164 of 2021
BETWEEN:
Megha Dabral & others ...Petitioners
(By Mr. Dushyant Mainali, Advocate)
AND:
State of Uttarakhand & others ... Respondents
(Ms. Mamta Bisht, learned Deputy Advocate General for
the State of Uttarakhand and Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned
counsel for respondent no. 5)
JUDGMENT
1. Petitioners are pursuing M.D. Pathology
Course in Government Medical College, Haldwani.
They want M.D. Pathology Course to be treated as
Non-Clinical/Para-Clinical course for purposes of
tuition fee.
2. By means of this writ petition, petitioners
have sought following reliefs:-
(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing the
respondents to consider M.D. Pathology as
Non-Clinical/Para-Clinical Course for the
purpose of providing benefit reduced
annual fee of Rs .1 Lakh to the petitioners.
(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing the
respondents to refund/adjust any enhanced
fee levied from the petitioners in treating
them as a student of Clinical P.G. Course
instead of Non/Para-Clinical Course.

2
3. Ms. Mamta Bisht, learned Deputy Advocate
General for the State submits that M.D. Pathology
Course is in huge demand, as services of Pathologist
are needed in every hospital, and these days
treatment of a patient begins on the basis of a
pathological report. She further submits that M.D.
Pathology Course cannot be equated with Non-Clinical/Para-Clinical Course like M.D. Anatomy, M.D.
Physiology, M.D. Biochemistry, M/s Pharmocology,
M.D. Forensic Science and M.D. Community Medicine.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that petitioners have made a representation to the
Competent Authority on 26.02.2021, but no decision
has been taken thereupon till today. Learned counsel
for the petitioners confines his prayer and submits
that petitioners may be permitted to make fresh
representation to the Competent Authority and the
Competent Authority be directed to take decision on
such representation.
5. In such view of the matter, the writ petition
is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to make
fresh representation to respondent no. 3 - Director,
Medical Education Department, Dehradun within two
weeks from today. If such representation is made
within stipulated time, respondent no. 3 shall
consider the same and take appropriate decision, in
accordance with law, within a period of six months
from the date of receipt of such representation.
(MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, J.)
Aswal
